title: cousinia sonchifolia
intro: Cousinia sonchifolia, commonly known as Qapang or Wild Bokhara, is a type of herbaceous plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Cousinia sonchifolia are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and enhance immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
